rules.title: My rules
rules.intro: What you are judged by. For reference only — only your keyholder can change these rules.
rules.glossary: “Chastity Device” is the category for whatever locks you in — belt or cage. It records locking and opening. Everything else you wear is its own category and is recorded as worn from–to, not locked.
rules.cleaningDesc: Whether, how often and how long you may briefly open for cleaning.
rules.autoInspectionsDesc: Inspection requests the system sends you on its own.
rules.offensesDesc: Which kinds of offence count for you. What does not count here is not held against you.

notice.title: The app looks new — and the colour now means something
notice.intro: It used to be a matter of taste: light or dark, plus a colour theme to pick from. From this version on it shows the state — which is why both switches are gone from the settings. There is nothing left to choose.
notice.legendKeyholder: Indigo is not a state but a place: that is what the keyholder area looks like.
notice.caveats: Two things belong with that: pink also shows during a cleaning break — a permitted opening is still an opening. And the lock tells open from closed by its shape, not only by its tone, so it still reads if green and pink are hard to tell apart.
notice.unchanged: No function is missing and nothing was switched off. The app does exactly what it did before.
